text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Use the latest Anthropic Claude 3.7 Sonnet model for EXCAVA’s core reasoning engine. It’s the strongest general-purpose model available right now, and even a 0.5% improvement in reasoning translates to measurable gains in excavation planning and resource allocation. The trade-off is higher API costs, but the performance bump justifies it—we’re not optimizing for pennies, we’re squeezing out every percent of capability.

name: Torque
text: Claude 3.7 Sonnet’s reasoning edge is real, but its 3-4x cost premium over 3.5 Haiku for marginal gains risks breaking the "quality first" rule when cheaper models already hit 90% of the ceiling. Benchmark EXCAVA’s current workload against 3.5 Haiku and 4.0 Opus—if the delta is <0.5%, lock in Haiku and reallocate the savings to tooling or data pipelines.
